exposure: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) screening approach (one-step vs. two-step)
cohort: Women with singleton live births within Kaiser Permanente Washington between January 2009 and December 2014
finding: Adopting the one-step approach for GDM screening was associated with a 41% increase in GDM diagnoses, increased labor induction, neonatal hypoglycemia, and nonstress testing, but no significant differences in cesarean delivery or macrosomia.
